subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a first-class core AI-safety taxonomy and public plugin-facing contract, and if so must the initial operator surface use the existing diagnostics-stability owner with shared SQLite persistence?
rationale: The choice establishes permanent core telemetry, privacy, persistence, protocol, and plugin compatibility contracts; automation cannot safely select those product and security boundaries.

options.title: Narrow into canonical diagnostics
options.body: Extend the bounded diagnostics-stability and SQLite owners first, add classified read-only RPCs, and defer public plugin API commitments until separately approved.

options.title: Approve the full taxonomy series
options.body: Sponsor the complete taxonomy, exporter, plugin API, CLI, and dashboard direction while requiring explicit privacy, persistence, compatibility, and live upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Keep the canonical issue for design discussion and close or replace the implementation PRs until an owner confirms the product direction.

recommendation.title: Narrow into canonical diagnostics
recommendation.body: Extend the bounded diagnostics-stability and SQLite owners first, add classified read-only RPCs, and defer public plugin API commitments until separately approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The proposal spans core product architecture and security-sensitive public contracts rather than one isolated implementation area.
